english.note: Use 店員 for the person serving customers in a shop or market.
Use this for a shop employee when the retail-shop context makes it clear that the person is serving or selling to customers.
This is the all-purpose word for an employee working in a shop.
Use this for the staff member serving customers in a shop rather than a general helper.

examples.english: This clerk quickly found the right size for me.
examples.traditional: 呢位店員好快就幫我搵到啱嘅尺碼。
